content.text:
Bloom Energy Trades at a 380x P/E Ratio. Here's What Has to Go Right to Justify That.: The supplied pre-cutoff copy frames AI data-center power demand as an opportunity, cites the 2025 product backlog and recent quarterly EPS, and discusses service backlog as a buffer while identifying slower AI spending as a risk. The 380x P/E, EPS annualization, and forward-looking backlog claim are author framing or calculations, not new issuer disclosures. (time=2026-10-03T02:21:12Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Bloom Energy Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results: The company reported full-year 2025 results and current total backlog of approximately $20 billion, with current product backlog approximately $6 billion and growth described as approximately 2.5x year over year. (time=2026-02-05; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Q4 2025 Supplemental Deck: The deck gives 2025 product backlog of about $6.0 billion versus $2.5 billion in 2024, and service backlog of about $14.0 billion versus $9.6 billion. It defines service backlog as contracted O&M revenue for installed and future-delivery systems; terms range from 5 to 20 years and are subject to annual termination for convenience. It also notes that the product-backlog figure excludes certain potential future commitments. (time=2026-02-05; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).

content.text:
In the AI Boom, This Energy Company Is Suddenly Flying High: Axios's post-earnings coverage described Bloom as positioned to benefit from AI data-center demand and faster on-site power deployment. It also reported Jefferies caution about competition, supply risks, and limited valuation margin for error. (time=2026-02-06T10:00:07Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Oracle Sends Force Majeure Notice on Its New Mexico Stargate Data Center: The report says Oracle sent a force-majeure notice concerning Project Jupiter and attributes the first report to Bloomberg. It says Oracle was not seeking to exit as tenant; Oracle said the project remained on schedule, and Blue Owl said its financial commitments were unchanged. It also reports a delayed gas pipeline and a pending air-quality permit for the Bloom fuel-cell system. (time=2026-09-24T11:11-07:00; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
